short: New insights into single-grain mechanical behavior from temp
title: New insights into single-grain mechanical behavior from temperature-dependent 3-D coherent X-ray diffraction

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: How strain heterogeneity inside one grain of a polycrystal evolves under load, and how its neighbours set it, has not been imaged in 3-D in situ. Coherent X-ray diffraction with a 2x2 um beam on one isolated grain during in-situ thermal cycling, with phase retrieval of its 3-D displacement field.
states.detail: Absorbed: a1 (HYP/gap), a3 (DES/method), a4 (DES/base_system), a6 (DES/variable_sweep), a7 (PRC/deposition), a8 (PRC/treatment), a12 (PRC/stimulus). Premises: Au elastic anisotropy factor is about 2.9; Thermal mismatch strain in a film on a substrate scales with the TEC difference times the temperature excursion

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Film has a strong {111} fibre texture: nearly all grains <111> out-of-plane, a few <100> grains. Before loading the grain already carries strong strain heterogeneity, in-plane and mainly along y, with uniform strain through the thickness.
states.detail: Absorbed: a10 (STR/microstructure/orientation), a11 (STR/phase/lattice), a13 (STR/phase/lattice), a14 (STR/microstructure/orientation). Premises: Scherrer size broadening: delta q_size = 2 pi / L sets the width expected from grain shape alone

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Single-grain out-of-plane strain vs temperature departs from the thermoelastic slope with hysteresis, and after the first heating it follows the film average. Dislocations cannot cross the boundaries to the misoriented neighbours along x, so they pile up and raise x-heterogeneity; their reversible motion gives quasi-reversibility

states.title: Performance state
states.head: In-situ CXD tracks the 3-D strain field of one sub-micron grain through a full thermal cycle
states.detail: Absorbed: a17 (PRF/service_capability). Premises: Oversampled coherent diffraction allows phase retrieval, and the inverse Fourier transform gives the displacement field

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Temperature-dependent 3-D CXD shows that single-grain strain heterogeneity evolves anisotropically and reversibly and is set by the in-plane misorientation of neighbours

nodes.title: evidence, F4, F6
nodes.head: Reconstructed xz phase maps show only vertical bands: phase is uniform along z at every temperature. delta q_x rises from about 1.3e-3 A-1 at 35 C to 4.9e-3 at 262 C on heating and falls to about 1.95e-3 at 20 C on cooling.
nodes.solves: On heating, strain heterogeneity in the grain grows mainly along x and falls back quasi-reversibly on cooling; it stays uniform along z
nodes.note: vertical bands in every xz map, incl. 240 C (F6c, restored by judge) cooling branch lies above heating branch and ends about 50% above the start: quasi-reversible only; all widths are 2-7x the size width 6.61e-4 A-1 printed on the panel F6c (240 C) restored by judge: it is plainly the 240 C phase-map panel; its micrograph cue is the scale-bar detector firing on the colour bar
nodes.detail: o6: Reconstructed xz phase maps show only vertical bands: phase is uniform along z at every temperature; o10: delta q_x rises from about 1.3e-3 A-1 at 35 C to 4.9e-3 at 262 C on heating and falls to about 1.95e-3 at 20 C on cooling; o11: xz phase maps: phase jumps along x increase from 50 C through 140 C to 240 C on heating and are fewer again at 50 C after cooling
